bugs.title: Analytics endpoints accept ?branch_id=2 from non-admins (Golden Rule 1 violation)
bugs.expected: Non-admin query param ?branch_id=2 is ignored; only caller branch data returned
bugs.actual: Controller accepts ?branch_id=2 from anyone and queries foreign branch data

bugs.title: processSupplierPayment trusts client body.branch_id without admin check
bugs.actual: Caller can set branch_id in request body to redirect payment record to other branches

bugs.title: GET / fails to redirect admin/superadmin to /dashboard because express.static serves index.html
bugs.spec: readme.md §Authentication; ADMIN / SUPER ADMIN redirect to /dashboard
bugs.expected: 302 redirect to /dashboard for admin and super admin
bugs.actual: express.static default index serves public/index.html with status 200

bugs.title: GET /dashboard.html static file has no requireAdmin check
bugs.spec: readme.md §Authentication; admin dashboard restricted to admins
bugs.expected: 302 redirect or 403 when non-admin employee requests dashboard.html
bugs.actual: 200 OK serves admin dashboard HTML to any authenticated employee

bugs.title: fixArabic throws in bidi-js argument mismatch and returns raw un-reshaped text
bugs.spec: Golden Rule 9; Arabic text must be shaped and reordered before PDF render
bugs.expected: Arabic characters shaped into Presentation Forms (U+FE70–U+FEFF) in visual RTL order
bugs.actual: bidiEngine.getReorderedString throws TypeError, caught, returns raw un-reshaped string

bugs.title: registered_clients in dashboard stats counts doctors only, ignoring pharmacies
bugs.expected: registered_clients equals total client base (doctors + pharmacies)
bugs.actual: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctors (pharmacies count omitted)

bugs.title: relation supplier_payments does not exist in database schema -> 500 on analytics payables
bugs.expected: 200 with payables list and recorded payments
bugs.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (relation supplier_payments does not exist)

gaps: jsPDF is loaded via CDN in browser HTML and not installed in package.json; full Node PDF generation is verified via text-shaping core and visual tests.
notes: Worker E test suite passed: 4 suites, 54 tests passed (including test.failing regressions for 7 bugs). 100% route coverage.
